description: Export per-location performance rollups for 7, 30 or 90 days as formula-safe RFC 4180 CSV (Pro). Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

days.description: How many past days to include: 7, 30 or 90. Defaults to 30.
